a.speaker: clerk
a.text: Welcome to Stealth & Glitter! Every print in here started as one of Skye’s designs. Everything is limited edition, including my patience.

back.speaker: clerk
back.text: Back again? The jackets missed you.

skye.speaker: clerk
skye.text: Obviously she went to Tokyo Fashion Week. Didn’t tell anyone. Iconic. I’d do the same.

about.speaker: clerk
about.text: This is her business. Every print starts as her design, and she built the online store around them. The Kura Gakuen Varsity Bomber leads the Collection.

end.speaker: clerk
end.text: Don’t touch the varsity jackets. Okay, touch them a little.
